key_concepts: Mechanical energy is the sum of potential and kinetic energy
Potential energy is stored energy due to position or height
Kinetic energy is energy of motion
Gravitational potential energy depends on an object’s position or height
Elastic potential energy is stored in objects that can act like springs or rubber bands
Chemical potential energy is stored in chemical bonds
Potential energy is calculated as PE = mgh
Kinetic energy is calculated as KE = 1/2mv²
The total mechanical energy in a system remains constant if only conservative forces act
Potential energy can be converted into kinetic energy and vice versa
Energy cannot disappear but is converted from one form to another
